A Non-Invasive End-to-End Silent Speech Neuroprosthetic Using Neck and Ear Wearables

Each sentence below was decoded from neck-and-ear muscle activity while the speaker mouthed it silently.

Reconstruction from voiced EMG

The examples above are silent EMG on a closed vocabulary. These are open-vocabulary sentences reconstructed from voiced EMG, with articulation and prosody both predicted from the signal. All four scored 0.00 — best case, not typical, so each card also shows its task’s average.
